candidates.explanation: Pipeline-aware conservative relaxation with downstream protection. Cuts only when pipeline is clearly excessive relative to recent demand and local backlog is low; boosts when pipeline is thin and backlog exists. Small coordinated corrections avoid starving downstream after delay.

Backlog-sensitive smoothing. Increase orders when backlog is high and pipeline is low; modest boost when backlog exists but pipeline is thin. Reduce only when pipeline is very high and no backlog, protecting downstream service.

Growth-adaptive damping. When recent demand exceeds baseline and pipeline is thin with backlog, boost to avoid stockouts; when growth is low and pipeline is excessive, reduce cautiously. Keeps corrections small and coordinated.

rules.when: growth > 1.2 and pipeline < recent and backlog > 0
